Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Britannica search result that stated J. Robert Oppenheimer was the director of the Los Alamos laboratory during the Manhattan Project and instead concluded it confirmed Norris Bradbury. This conflated the wartime scientific director (Oppenheimer) with his postwar successor (Bradbury), leading to the incorrect final answer.
